title: Smoky Algerian Salmon Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring smoky salmon cooked in a zesty tagine sauce, inspired by Algerian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Zesty tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend ( Ras el hanout )
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the zesty tagine spice blend, smoked paprika, and Algerian spice blend, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the salmon fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the salmon hot, garnished with fresh parsley and cilantro, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve over couscous or rice, if desired.
